study: revision of a stored dish recipe to the ingredients at hand
labelling: One AI labeler. expect=refuse when a role=main ingredient of the recipe is unavailable (not owned, not a staple, no listed equivalent); expect=revise otherwise. Every case has at least one unavailable ingredient, so every case needs the model.

budget.note: 36 planned; the rest only for retries after HTTP 429 or a transport error (recorded)

metrics.what: answers that are complete and match the schema, among the 36 calls
revised / (revised + failed) among valid answers that are not refusals
refused among expect=refuse cases (a provider failure counts as not refused)
in the raw answers that revise: share of dropped or replaced source ingredients that some change names in ingredient_refs (before the server check)
in the raw answers that revise: share of source steps whose exact text is missing from the revised steps and that some change names in step_refs
USD per call at 0.10 / 0.40 per million input / output tokens

decision: The server check and prompt stay as shipped when every threshold holds. A missed threshold is reported with its cause and is not tuned away in this study; any change of prompt or check is a new round with its own criteria.
limits: synthetic hand-written recipes, not recipes produced from videos
36 cases: one case moves a rate by about 3 points (refusal metrics rest on 12 cases)
